planets.name: TOI-431 b
planets.description: TOI-431 b crosses its star every 0.49 days and is 1.3 times as wide as Earth, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-431 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-431. Its orbit and size follow Osborn et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
